stem: What is the central idea of the selection "Tradition with a Twist"?

options.label: A
options.text: Trying traditional food from different countries is important.

options.label: B
options.text: Helping people keep traditions in your community feels good.

options.label: C
options.text: New versions of traditional dishes should be valued.

options.label: D
options.text: Traditions can teach people how to be successful when they cook.
